project_type: Zero-dependency Node.js server + vanilla JS frontend (premium AI chat application)
verification_instructions: Run `node --check server.js` for syntax validation. No automated tests.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot reach external services. Use env -u NODE_OPTIONS when running node.
contribution_requirements: Zero-dependency project - no npm install needed. All code in server.js and public/.
key_patterns: Single-file server (1900 lines), single-file frontend (4300 lines), IIFE pattern on frontend, streaming SSE proxy, file-based JSON persistence
directory_structure: MAX/ root: server.js (Node HTTP server), public/ (static frontend), max-chats/ (committed chat exports - should not be in git), data/ (gitignored runtime state)
